question: For each instance display name, what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory size (MEMORY_MB) across that instance’s records, considering only instances that are not deleted and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'?        MAX(memory_mb) - MIN(memory_mb) AS range,
       VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS variance,
       STDDEV(memory_mb) AS stddev
FROM instances
WHERE deleted = 0
  AND display_name LIKE '%prime%'
